fullFinalRecommendations.title: London City Grid
fullFinalRecommendations.targetOrConstraints: Region/Fort constraint; applies only to using subroutines of noisy icebreakers during runs on this fort.
fullFinalRecommendations.rationale: Noisy-Icebreaker-Hate ist subtype-/matchup-spezifisch wie Worm- oder Stealth-Hate. Das ist ein taktisches Tax-/Constraint-Signal, aber kein stabiler `corp.ice_tax_glacier`- oder `corp.remote_scoring`-Anker.

fullFinalRecommendations.title: Self-Destruct

strategySupportPairs.rationale: On-access Self-Destruct is clear remote ambush payoff.
Net damage scales with trashed cards and can create flatline pressure, with board-cost risk.

fullFinalRecommendations.targetOrConstraints: Trashes other installed cards in/on the fort; own-board risk is broader than own ICE.
fullFinalRecommendations.rationale: risk.trash_own_rezzed_ice is too narrow.

fullFinalRecommendations.title: Shock Treatment

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Mass rig-trash on access is ambush punish.
The payoff requires four or more tags and consumes tag/trace pressure.

fullFinalRecommendations.targetOrConstraints: Runner installed hardware/programs; four-tag threshold is a condition.
fullFinalRecommendations.rationale: Use specific tag-threshold condition instead of risk.requires_tagged_runner.

fullFinalRecommendations.title: Sterdroid

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Temporary targeted strength boost can increase break cost on a key ICE, but it is not inherently remote-scoring protection.

fullFinalRecommendations.targetOrConstraints: TargetProfile needed: choose a piece of ICE; visible/known ICE state only, no hidden Runner knowledge.
fullFinalRecommendations.rationale: `ice.strength_modifier` ist zu generisch und nicht Corp-seitig. `remote.scoring_protection` und der Remote-Scoring-Pair sind zu breit, weil Sterdroid ein zielbares ICE-Buff-Werkzeug ist, kein remote-spezifischer Schutz.

fullFinalRecommendations.title: Street Enforcer

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Start-of-run credit loss scales with Runner tag count; this is primarily a tag payoff, not a generic glacier or remote-scoring card.

fullFinalRecommendations.targetOrConstraints: Installed in a data fort; effect scales with Runner tag count at the start of each run on that fort.
fullFinalRecommendations.rationale: Die v1-Zuordnung zu drei Strategien überdehnt die Karte. Fachlich ist Street Enforcer ein Tag-Payoff. ICE-Tax und Remote-Scoring sollten nicht zusätzlich ankern, weil die Tax nur aus bereits vorhandenen Tags entsteht.
